title: Persist READY integration handoffs instead of expiring mailbox custody offers
outcome: A complete READY package enters the existing integration owner's durable work queue and wakes that owner, so restart or an expired mailbox offer never requires a manual re-offer or another evidence assembly.
acceptance: A complete READY package stays durably findable by its integration owner without an expiring custody offer: the author labels the item ready-to-land after its immutable READY manifest note and before offering or releasing, and the owner's queue is engram work ls --label ready-to-land (procedure recorded in project memory rules-merger-role, READY QUEUE BY LABEL)

Recovery after disconnect, restart, an expired offer or a lapsed author claim reads the queue by label and the package by its manifest note, with no repeated evidence assembly or manual re-offer; existing landing authority and integration checks stay unchanged

Return or abandonment while open is recorded by a reason note followed by removing the label, and completed items keep the label outside the open listing; the procedure states explicitly that wake, redelivery and landing refusal of an abandoned manifest stay procedural (the Merger's admission decision), not enforced

A recorded measurement on a scratch store (100, 10k and 100k completed labelled items with a fixed small pending set, plus an open-unlabelled growth control) shows the label queue query's work and query plan; if it grows with history rather than the pending set, the query is fixed in place with a counting regression test
